title: Patric Simmerud (1963-)
name: Patric Simmerud
description: Patric Simmerud. Born on the 13th of October 1963 in Stockholm. Composer and sound artist.
bibliography: Thunell, Helena: "Tiden går inte längre. Interview with Patric Simmerud", Nutida Musik , nr 258/2016, s. 32-37.
works_summary: Selected works: Orchestra ( Fluctuations , Villes englouties ), Wind orchestra ( AN ), Chamber ensembles ( de-housing , Frameworks , Pärlor från Svin , Requiem , Soon - Kilroy go home , To remember the still unseen days, Hokahey, WIP ), Chamber ensembles with electronics ( Kaiso , Wo , Soli , Transients formants and gestures, Vassala , Voop ) Choir ( De ljudlösa , Veni vidi vici ), Electroacoustic ( Tiden går inte längre , Wish tree ), Chamber opera ( Absence ).
